original_400k.stdout:
usage: run_experiment.py [-h] --mode {compare,generate,train}
                         [--resume RESUME]

Run the original TimeRCD 400k workflow

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {compare,generate,train}
  --resume RESUME       Absolute checkpoint path for train mode; defaults to
                        the latest checkpoint

ablation_v9.stdout:
usage: run_experiment.py [-h] --config CONFIG --run-id RUN_ID --mode
                         {audit,smoke,train,eval,report,all}
                         [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                         [--parallel {none,data_parallel}]
                         [--gpu-ids GPU_IDS [GPU_IDS ...]]

Run TimeRCD v9 ablation experiments

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to a JSON experiment config
  --run-id RUN_ID       Unique output directory name
  --mode {audit,smoke,train,eval,report,all}
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        Checkpoint path for eval mode
  --parallel {none,data_parallel}
                        Override runtime.parallel; default uses JSON config
  --gpu-ids GPU_IDS [GPU_IDS ...]
                        Visible CUDA device ids for data_parallel; first id
                        gathers outputs
